title: Tavern on George
venue_description:
Tavern on George

A bi-level pub with a grand, open-timbered dining room on George Street, Tavern on George has become New Brunswick's most reliable home for live jazz, anchored by its long-running partnership with the New Brunswick Jazz Project.

Atmosphere and Setting

The room pairs a casual pub menu of burgers and housemade donuts with a genuinely serious live-music program. It draws a mixed crowd of Rutgers-area regulars, downtown diners, and dedicated jazz listeners who come specifically for the music.

Live Jazz and the Open Jam

The New Brunswick Jazz Project books live jazz at the tavern every Tuesday and Thursday from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Tuesday nights are built around the Emerging Artists Series and Open Jam Session: a featured guest quartet or quintet — past leaders have included Tahj Walsh, Don Solomon, Danny Allen, Jeremy Leon, and Jeff Andolaro — opens the evening before turning the stage over to an open jam for musicians in the room. Players interested in sitting in can reach out in advance through the New Brunswick Jazz Project's musician information page.

Other Events

Thursday evenings bring a second weekly night of straight-ahead jazz booked by the same organization, and the venue's location on George Street also puts it a short walk from the New Brunswick Jazz Project's outdoor summer series along Livingston Avenue.

Good to Know

Tavern on George is located at 361 George Street, New Brunswick, NJ. Reservations are recommended on the busier Tuesday and Thursday jazz nights.

title: George Street Co-op
venue_description:
George Street Co-op

A few blocks from the Rutgers campus, George Street Co-op is a member-owned natural foods store and cafe built around a mission of healthy food, a healthy planet, and cooperation. Once a week its cafe space doubles as a genuine community stage for the Third Space Open Mic.

Atmosphere and Setting

This is a community-space open mic rather than a bar or club: no alcohol, no cover charge, and a welcoming, cooperative-minded crowd. The co-op describes its open mic as a safe third space for anyone looking for a comfortable place to spend the evening, whether performing or just listening.

The Third Space Open Mic

Held every Thursday from 8:00 PM, with sign-ups starting at 7:30 PM, the open mic welcomes music, poetry, and comedy in the same rotation. Host Manny keeps the sign-up list, and performers can also call the co-op ahead of time to reserve a slot.

Other Events

The co-op has additionally hosted a separate comedy-only open mic on select Sunday evenings, alongside its day-to-day role as a cooperative grocery serving the New Brunswick community.

Good to Know

George Street Co-op is located at 89 Morris Street, New Brunswick, NJ. As a small community space, seating is limited, so arriving by the 7:30 PM sign-up time is recommended for performers.
